reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商与发行商同为 Northern Studio LLC）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 48，仅覆盖首页）；首页没有命中 AI 关键词的主题，因此没有相关帖可读。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次，登记该次响应的 6 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源：AI Transparency Index 的本作条目逐字转录这条清单式披露原文，未添加独立信息。其余 5 条是一个行业站的 Steam AI 披露榜单页、genplay.gg 的即将上线列表页、一个第三方本作宣传与攻略站的两页（分别介绍试玩版与发售日）以及本作的试玩版商店页（App ID 4759840），均不含正式版披露的可核验原文，未登记为来源。本作的披露形态与其它条目不同：只有关键词、没有句子，因此无法判断列出的资产是全部还是部分、也无法判断生成或加工方式；本站按清单出现的顺序逐项映射到翻译与美术，其余领域记为未说明而不是未使用。检索范围记录在 coverageLimits，未检索到独立报道不等于未使用 AI。

english.summary: A cooking roguelike dungeon crawler released on Oct 25, 2026, self-developed and self-published by Northern Studio LLC and filed under Action, Indie and RPG. The Steam AI disclosure is a bare list with no verb: Language Translation, Skill Icons, Dish Illustrations, Loading Illustrations. This site records translation and art as used on that list and the remaining six areas as areas the disclosure does not address. Because the list never says whether the named assets are all or part of the game, or how they were produced, every finding rests on the developer own statement and none of it has been independently audited.
english.reviewNote: Checked the complete English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (Northern Studio LLC is both developer and publisher) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 48, first page only), where no topic matches the AI keyword search, so no thread needed reading. This title was searched once, that one response holds 6 results and 1 raw source was read: the AI Transparency Index entry transcribes this list verbatim and adds nothing beyond it. The other 5 results were an industry-site chart page of Steam AI disclosures, the coming-soon listing on genplay.gg, two pages of a third-party promotion and walkthrough site for this title (one about the demo, one about the release date) and the demo store page under App ID 4759840; none carries verifiable text from the released games disclosure, so none is registered as a source. This disclosure differs from the others in the batch: it holds keywords rather than sentences, so the scope, the share of assets and the production method are all unstated, which is why the unnamed areas are recorded as not addressed rather than as not used. The search scope is recorded in coverageLimits and no independent report was found, which is not proof that AI was not used.
